edits.value_json: "字源’s 包 entry reads 勹 as wrapping 巳 in a semantic construction conveying 胞衣. Its separate 勹 entry says 勹 has an independent origin, rejecting derivations from 伏 or 旬; this concerns 勹’s own history and does not rule out a role in 包. Received-form analyses also propose 勹 as a sound component, while its role in the earliest formation remains unsettled."
